use: haltere.vision.gap_cue near_on_path: the predicted flown direction flies straight along the declared velocity for delay_s after a frame, then turns towards the aim at a_lat_mps2. Declared values (the M2 design kinematic budget, m2design/anatomy/budget.py), not fitted per course.

fast_pd.declared_from: camera age 0.07-0.14 s + confirmation ~0.1 s + PD tracking lag 0.11-0.14 s; lateral acceleration p99 of PD flights

brain08.declared_from: camera age + confirmation + brain lag behind the request 0.32-0.39 s; observed lateral acceleration 6.6-6.8 m/s^2 p99

log_check.method: pure delay + first-order lag of flown horizontal velocity to the pilot's commanded velocity (grid search, 50 Hz), camera image age (median), one frame of confirmation at the camera rate; lateral acceleration percentiles above 3 m/s from 0.1 s differences. Response = age + 1 / rate + delay + tau.

minus-brain08-slow35-01.note: poor fit: the brain did not follow the 3.5 m/s request

log_check.verdict: declared values kept: PD 0.30 s matches 0.25-0.29 s; brain-08 0.55 s lies inside 0.48-0.89 s (short Minus windows fit worst); lateral capacities match the p99 of the longer flights (short straight Minus windows never use them)
